description: Show your credit transaction history: every debit and refund behind the current balance, most recent first. Each entry has a `type` ('debit' or 'refund'), the `job_id` it belongs to, the `amount`, a `reason` and a `timestamp`. Use this to explain WHY the balance is what it is — e.g. a job that debited 100 credits and was then refunded on exhaustion/failure shows up as a matching debit + refund pair, so the balance returning to its prior value is a legitimate refund, not the debit having failed to apply. Does not run a new discovery and does not cost credits. Pass `limit` to bound how many recent transactions are returned (default 50, max 200).
name: get_credit_ledger
title: Get credit ledger
